sections.title: Math & shape primitives
sections.desc: Circle (`I`) and rotated-rect (`b`) collision primitives with location/size/rotation accessors.

sections.title: Fighter
sections.desc: Fighter entity: sprite-sheet body animations (idle/walk/punch/kick/crouch), per-move timers and cooldowns (static defaults), hit boxes, health.

sections.title: FighterEngine core
sections.desc: `A`: engine orchestration — Begin/Reset loops, round management, attack-range and wall-margin rules for the two fighters.

sections.title: Input & input replay
sections.desc: `S`: keyboard mapping (MoveLeft…), input-sequence history (maxInputsSequence) used for netcode state recovery and replays.

sections.title: Menu & UI screens
sections.desc: `C`: intro/logo screens, menu options list, fade/copy timers, pixel-text UI drawing.

sections.title: Multiplayer (Supabase signaling)
sections.desc: `T`: WebRTC-over-Supabase-realtime netcode — session codes, connection state, full-state recovery for desyncs, error cooldown. Live-only; offline it just reports no connection.

sections.title: Game renderer & audio director
sections.desc: `g`: match drawing (bar, intro sheets), gravity/friction constants, frame-accurate SFX triggers (frameSfx/frameStamp), camera zoom-out, win/lose flow.
